children: Overview
US online health insurance marketplace's Q3 revenue missed analyst expectations
Company reported Q3 loss per share of $1.57
Outlook
eHealth reiterates FY26 revenue guidance of $405.0 mln to $445.0 mln
Company reiterates FY26 GAAP net income guidance of $8.0 mln to $25.0 mln
eHealth reiterates FY26 adjusted EBITDA guidance of $55.0 mln to $75.0 mln
Result Drivers
MARKETING SPEND REDUCTION – Revenue declined 60% as eHealth cut variable marketing outside major enrollment periods and shifted advisors toward existing-member engagement
LIFETIME ADVISORY MODEL – The model improved 90-day retention for the Q2 Medicare Advantage cohort, while Q3 ancillary cross-sell rates nearly doubled yr/yr
